name: @texuli/mcp

tools.name: catalog.search
tools.description: Search the built, content-addressed Texuli component catalog by text, group and emit tier. Returns the catalog hash and file name, the match count and one summary per component (id, package, label, summary, tier, group, emit tiers). Limits: input up to 4096 bytes, at most 100 items, 5000 ms budget.

query.description: Text to match against component ids, labels and summaries.

group.description: An exact manifest group id, e.g. "display" or "forms".

tier.description: Keep only components this emit tier may place: untrusted is what agent output may use; developer is app-authored code.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 100, default 50).

tools.name: catalog.validate
tools.description: Validate one candidate catalog manifest, or a set (which also catches duplicate ids), without writing files. Returns valid and a list of diagnostics, each with a code, a JSONPath, a message and a hint. Limits: input up to 1000000 bytes, at most 500 items, 5000 ms budget.

manifest.description: A candidate catalog manifest (id, package, label, summary, tier, props, examples …).

items.description: A candidate catalog manifest (id, package, label, summary, tier, props, examples …).

inputSchema.$comment: Exactly one of manifest or manifests.

tools.name: component.get
tools.description: Read one component manifest from the catalog by id. Returns { component }: its props with kinds and schemas, events, worked examples, useWhen and dontUseWhen guidance, accessibility notes and the emit tiers that may place it (an empty emit list means agent output may not). Limits: input up to 1024 bytes, 5000 ms budget.

id.description: A catalog component id, e.g. "card" (find ids with catalog.search).

tools.name: example.search
tools.description: Find worked manifest examples (props an agent can copy) by component id and/or example id, or search their titles and descriptions. Returns the match count and each example with its component id and package. Limits: input up to 4096 bytes, at most 100 items, 5000 ms budget.

componentId.description: A catalog component id, e.g. "card" (find ids with catalog.search).

exampleId.description: An exact example id within the component, e.g. "basic".

query.description: Text to match against example ids, titles and descriptions.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 100, default 50).

tools.name: blueprint.validate
tools.description: Validate a blueprint draft (a catalog tree, an array of trees, or a texuli-blueprint envelope, migrated first) with the catalog's draft checks: structure, sinks, tree limits, component ids, tiers and prop schemas, deep block and document schemas, grammar and the frame root. Returns valid, status, tier, migratedFrom and diagnostics with the catalog's stable codes. Limits: input up to 270336 bytes, at most 512 items, 5000 ms budget.

draft.description: The blueprint: a catalog tree { id, props, children }, an array of trees, or a texuli-blueprint envelope (format, version, id, catalog hash from catalog.search, status, createdAt, updatedAt, generator, tree). At most 512 nodes. schema-form, canvas and spreadsheet nodes and data-source bindings are refused: this server has no validator for them.

tier.description: The tier to validate at: untrusted (agent output, the default) or developer (app-authored). A tier the draft declares is ignored.

fragment.description: Accept any roots (a fragment). Default false: one frame root (layout-page, layout-doc, layout-deck, document, canvas or data-dashboard).

tools.name: block.list
tools.description: List the content block types the blocks-* components render (table, stat, cta, poll …), optionally for one component or matching words. Returns the match count and, per type, the component that renders it, a label and when to use it; read one shape with block.schema. Limits: input up to 1024 bytes, at most 32 items, 5000 ms budget.

component.description: Only the types this blocks-* component renders, e.g. "blocks-data".

query.description: Words to match against the type, its label and its useWhen notes.

tools.name: block.schema
tools.description: Read the shape of one content block type: the component that renders it, its fields as compact text and as a JSON Schema (required fields are the ones the validator refuses a block without), examples that validate in a blueprint, limits, when to use it and whether it can pass blueprint.validate today. Returns what a blocks-* node’s block prop needs. Limits: input up to 1024 bytes, 5000 ms budget.

type.description: A block type from block.list, e.g. "table" or "cta".

tools.name: theme.search
tools.description: Search the Texuli theme library (200+ offline themes) by words, category, collection, mood or tag. Returns the match count and each theme’s metadata: id, name, description, category, collection, mood, tags, contrast level and whether it is dark-first. Limits: input up to 4096 bytes, at most 500 items, 5000 ms budget.

query.description: Words that must all match the id, name, tags, mood, category, collection or description; results are ranked.

mood.description: One mood the theme must have.

limit.description: How many themes to return (1 to 500, default 50).

tools.name: theme.get
tools.description: Read the full token definition of one library theme by id. Returns { theme }: its id, name, description and every light and dark color, radius, font and chart token, ready to compile or apply. Limits: input up to 1024 bytes, 5000 ms budget.

id.description: A theme id from theme.search, e.g. "violet" or "enterprise-neutral".

tools.name: theme.preview
tools.description: Preview one library theme in light or dark mode. Returns its summary, the key tokens of that mode (background, foreground, primary, border, radius, font …) and the WCAG 2.x AA contrast report for both modes (aa.pass and issue counts). Limits: input up to 1024 bytes, 5000 ms budget.

id.description: A theme id from theme.search, e.g. "violet" or "enterprise-neutral".

mode.description: The mode whose tokens to show (default light); the AA report covers both.

tools.name: deck.run
tools.description: Inspect, lint and convert a Texuli deck on the shared v2 model: capabilities, the JSON Schema, layouts, lint, inspect, from-markdown and to-markdown. Pure compute; returns { result } with the command output (ok, issues, deck, markdown …). Limits: input up to 2100000 bytes, 10000 ms budget.

command.description: capabilities, schema and layouts take nothing; lint, inspect and to-markdown take deck; from-markdown takes markdown.

deck.description: A JSON deck (formatVersion 2) for lint, inspect or to-markdown.

markdown.description: Deck Markdown (front matter, one section per slide) for from-markdown.

tools.name: document.run
tools.description: Create, validate, inspect, patch and convert a Texuli document (spec 0.7.0): capabilities, the JSON Schema, validate, inspect, a bounded RFC 6902 patch (at most 1000 operations), from-markdown, to-markdown and to-blueprint. Returns { result } with the command output; PDF and DOCX are document.export. Limits: input up to 2100000 bytes, at most 1000 items, 10000 ms budget.

command.description: capabilities and schema take nothing; from-markdown takes markdown; every other command takes document.

patch.description: RFC 6902 operations for patch (add, remove, replace, move, copy, test).

tier.description: The URL policy tier links and media are checked at (default untrusted).

tools.name: document.export
tools.description: Write a Texuli document as PDF or DOCX bytes with the owned writers, links and media checked at the tier. Returns { result } with ok, mime, byteLength, base64 bytes (no files are written), diagnostics and, for PDF, pageCount. Needs Node. Limits: input up to 2100000 bytes, 30000 ms budget.

tier.description: The URL policy tier links and media are checked at (default untrusted).

tools.name: deck
tools.description: Deprecated alias of deck.run; removed in 0.10.0. Call deck.run instead. Inspect, lint and convert a Texuli deck on the shared v2 model: capabilities, the JSON Schema, layouts, lint, inspect, from-markdown and to-markdown. Pure compute; returns { result } with the command output (ok, issues, deck, markdown …).

command.description: capabilities, schema and layouts take nothing; lint, inspect and to-markdown take deck; from-markdown takes markdown.

deck.description: A JSON deck (formatVersion 2) for lint, inspect or to-markdown.

markdown.description: Deck Markdown (front matter, one section per slide) for from-markdown.

tools.name: document
tools.description: Deprecated alias of document.run and document.export; removed in 0.10.0. Call document.run or document.export instead. Create, validate, inspect, patch and convert a Texuli document (spec 0.7.0): capabilities, the JSON Schema, validate, inspect, a bounded RFC 6902 patch (at most 1000 operations), from-markdown, to-markdown and to-blueprint. Returns { result } with the command output; PDF and DOCX are document.export. Write a Texuli document as PDF or DOCX bytes with the owned writers, links and media checked at the tier. Returns { result } with ok, mime, byteLength, base64 bytes (no files are written), diagnostics and, for PDF, pageCount. Needs Node.

command.description: capabilities and schema take nothing; from-markdown takes markdown; to-pdf and to-docx (routed to document.export) and every other command take document.

tier.description: The URL policy tier links and media are checked at (default untrusted).

instructions: Texuli is a Svelte 5 component library with a closed agent catalog. Tools are group.verb operations: search the component catalog (catalog.search), read manifests (component.get) and worked examples (example.search), list content block types and read the shape and examples of each (block.list, block.schema), validate blueprint drafts (blueprint.validate) and catalog manifests, search, read and preview themes with their WCAG AA report, and run deck and document commands. Every tool states its limits and returns structured JSON; failures are isError results with a stable code (invalid-input, input-too-large, not-found, runtime-unavailable, timeout …). Resources: texuli://catalog, texuli://llms/full, texuli://component/{id}, texuli://docs/{slug}, texuli://theme/{id} and texuli://schema/{name}. Prompts build-ui, theme-blueprint and convert-deck walk through the main jobs. The remote endpoint also lists site.pages, site.read and site.search, which list, read (as Markdown) and search the pages of texuli.com. The 0.8 tool names (catalog, component, validate, example, theme, deck, document) are deprecated aliases. Read-only: nothing writes files or reaches the network.
